title: BLITZ as an add-on on LIT's funded Builder 50K (only while LIT is flat)
question: Owner 2026-10-28: does BLITZ add money next to LIT without breaking the one-position / no-hedge rules?
verdict: LIT's MFFU Builder 50K slot (eval -> funded -> payouts, 6-month MC, net of evals): LIT alone H1 $823/mo, H2 $798, 2021-25 $-7; + BLITZ once funded (20% of the room, <= $450 a trade, only while LIT is flat) $1124 / $1088 / $9 (paired +$301 / +$290 / +$16 a month, better in 75.3% / 75.6% of paths); LIT's eval odds unchanged. Real 2026 path: $7,816 -> $10,925. Stored trades: BLITZ as it trades there, at $450 a trade.
notes: tools/scalp_na_combo.py lit_grid / lit_checks / lit_why (tools/uprisk.py + tools/div_stack.py engines)

params.rule: BLITZ = the noise-area momentum scalp (scalp-momentum.md na_scalp) + one filter: trade only when the PRIOR day's 09:30-16:00 range is at least 0.8 x its 14-day mean. Checks at the 1m closes of 11:00, 11:30 ... 15:30 ET: a close above the 09:30 open x (1 + sigma) buys, below open x (1 - sigma) sells (sigma = mean |close / 09:30 open - 1| at that minute over the last 14 sessions); market at the next open (+1 tick); stop 1.5 x the 14-bar ATR of 5m bars; after +1R the stop trails 1.5R behind the best price; out after 30 minutes or at 15:55; one position, max 6 a day, -3R day stop.

method: LIT replay (engine/lit.py run_x, the same code as the live loop engine/lit_live.py): 2026 entries on 1-minute bars, 2021-25 on 5-minute bars (reference); live sizing + weekly stop; costs included
